_comment: Everything the ingestion and generation pipelines are pinned to.
ADR-0006 scopes the reproducibility claim to what is recorded here, so a
value missing from this file is a value the claim does not cover.
SERVING LOCATION IS PART OF THE PIN, not just the model string. Measured
2026-08-07: gemini-3.6-flash serves from Vertex location=global and
returns 404 in us-central1 and asia-south1. Those are independent
variables. The 404 was the loud failure; the dangerous version is a region
serving a different build behind the same string, which would look like
corpus/ is empty until Phase 2. The parse and extraction blocks are
recorded here now so the shape does not change when it lands.

generation.note: Gemini Enterprise Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI (renamed May 2026)

CLASSIFY.note: not yet exercised; verify location before first use

EXTRACT.note: Phase 2. Confirm data-residency implications of location=global before sending real documents; see ADR-0009.

generation.sampling_note: temperature, top_p and top_k are deprecated and ignored on these models and return HTTP 400 on later ones. Sending them would look like a determinism control while doing nothing. See ADR-0006.

parse.note: OCR is enabled for every document, not only the scans, so one pipeline is being measured rather than several. RapidOCR needs opencv-python-headless in this environment: docling reports 'RapidOCR is not installed' when the real failure is a missing libGL.so.1.

extraction.note: Phase 2. `make ingest-verify` re-runs the pipeline into a temp directory and diffs. Reproducibility here is MEASURED, not asserted from a parameter.
